| ![FO76 publicteam xpd.png](https://images.fallout.wiki/thumb/1/15/FO76_publicteam_xpd.png/30px-FO76_publicteam_xpd.png) | For an overview of all train stations in *Fallout 76* , see Train stations. | 

**Grafton Station** is a train station in the Toxic Valley region of Appalachia.

A part of the long-defunct network of train stations along the Red Line, the facility consists of a track-side platform and station building. Situated in the heart of Toxic Valley, the location provided ancillary services such as a staffed ticket sales counter and automated ticket machines before the Great War. The station was subsequently commandeered and turned into a trading post by the Responders.

The station houses a vendor bot, Punch Card Machine, and a Tinker's Workbench, along with seating and a toilet. There is a Cooking Station at the south end of the platform and a sleeping bag at the entrance to the station. There is one outbuilding to the north of the station which contains a Weapons Workbench and a wood pile at the western door. The location also has a fusion generator outside housing a Fusion Core. A second outbuilding to the north houses a Chemistry Station.

As of the *Locked & Loaded* update, a Punch Card Machine was added to all train stations.

Grafton Station appears in *Fallout 76*.
